structure.name: Composite Honeycomb Light Bus
structure.description: Carbon fiber reinforced polymer structure with aluminum honeycomb core optimized for light orbiter or small rover missions.

structure.name: Titanium-Aluminum Heavy Science Platform
structure.description: Rigid high-load aerospace structure designed for heavy rover operations (Curiosity/Perseverance class) with high mechanical vibration damping.

power.name: UltraFlex High-Efficiency Solar Arrays
power.description: InSight/Phoenix class circular fold-out solar panels with triple-junction InGaP/InGaAs/Ge cells providing high specific power (W/kg).

power.name: Multi-Mission Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (MMRTG)
power.description: Plutonium-238 dioxide thermal decay converter providing steady day/night electrical power and excess heat regardless of dust storms or latitude.

propulsion.name: Hydrazine / NTO Bi-propellant Main Engine
propulsion.description: High-thrust chemical bipropellant engine for Mars Orbit Insertion (MOI) and critical trajectory burns.

propulsion.name: High-Thrust Bipropellant Dual Engine
propulsion.description: Twin dual-mode chemical engines delivering rapid Mars orbit insertion and high-velocity trajectory maneuvers.

propulsion.name: Hydrazine Monopropellant RCS Thruster Quad
propulsion.description: Precision attitude control and midcourse trim thruster clusters using catalyzed hydrazine decomposition.

telecom.name: High-Gain 2.1m Parabolic Reflector (X/Ka-Band)
telecom.description: Steerable dual-band dish antenna communicating directly with NASA Deep Space Network (Goldstone, Madrid, Canberra).

telecom.name: Electra UHF Proximity Relay Transceiver
telecom.description: Proximity-1 protocol transceiver for surface-to-orbiter communications relay.

thermal.name: Passive Bimetallic Louver Panel
thermal.description: Lightweight passive thermal louvers that open and close based on thermal expansion of bimetallic springs.

thermal.name: Loop Heat Pipe & Active Louver Thermal Array
thermal.description: Passive variable-emittance louvers coupled with ammonia loop heat pipes for core avionics temperature regulation.
